Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A real iPhone driven from inside a DSH conversation — the agent's tool calls on the left, the live d"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"evice panel on the right"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why DSH iOS Simulator"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"DSH iOS Simulator gives the agent a real iOS Simulator inside the conversation — and gives you the p"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ixels. The agent can boot a device, build and run an Xcode project or Swift package, drive the UI by"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" accessibility identity or by OCR text, read unified logs, and inspect processes, backtraces, and le"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"aks, while a live stream of the device renders in a persistent sidebar panel where you can tap, drag"},{"id":"p10s5","text":", rotate, and press Home directly on the video. The same verbs also work on a real iPhone connected "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"over USB: the plugin builds and launches WebDriverAgent on the phone, tunnels its control and screen"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" ports over loopback, and streams the device into the same panel, cards, and tools. No image blocks,"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" no screen-recording files: visual bytes reach the UI only through signed, expiring URLs served by t"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ing files: visual bytes reach the UI only through signed, expiring URLs served by the DSH webserver."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| 🖥️ **Live simulator in the conversation** | A serve-sim MJPEG stream of the booted device, proxied"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" through signed `/_dsh/dsh-ios/*` routes into a persistent right-side panel — the browser never touc"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"hes serve-sim's port. |
| 📱 **Real iPhone over USB** | `ios_real_start_wda` builds and launches WebD"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"riverAgent on a connected phone and tunnels its control (REST) and screen (MJPEG) ports over loopbac"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"k; the same panel, tools, cards, and status capsule then drive the phone. The device must be unlocke"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"d, and every real-account tap is gated by the plugin's identify-before-tap rules. |
| 🛠️ **22 agent "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"tools** | Devices, boot/shutdown, screenshot, interact, build & run, unified logs, AXe-backed UI tre"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"e + tap-by-element, list/feed row actions, Vision OCR find/tap, SwiftUI preview hot reload, processe"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"s, backtrace, leaks, app info. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- The browser never talks to serve-sim's port. Every byte crosses the DSH webserver origin through p"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"lugin-owned `/_dsh/dsh-ios/*` routes: `/stream/<token>` (MJPEG proxy), `/screenshot/<token>` (cached"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" PNG), `/ws?token=…` (HID control relay), plus `/grant`, `/capture`, and `/status` endpoints.
- Toke"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ns are HMAC-SHA256 capabilities (`base64url(payload).base64url(mac)`) expiring within 10 minutes, si"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"gned with a per-DSH-home key (`<DSH_HOME>/cache/dsh-ios/stream-access.key`, 0600, created atomically"},{"id":"p15s6","text":").
- Every route applies a loopback/trusted transport fence before any capability is consulted: loop"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"back peer address, loopback `Host` (DNS-rebinding rejected), and Fetch-Metadata/Origin checks. The s"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"creenshot route serves only files inside the plugin cache directory (symbolic links refused, `realpa"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"th` containment).
- serve-sim runs as a foreground child on loopback only, in a dedicated port range"},{"id":"p15s10","text":" (3181–3244), so a user's own serve-sim on port 3100 is never touched; `--host` is never used.
- **R"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"eal-device transport** — the WebDriverAgent control (REST, device port 8100) and screen (MJPEG, port"},{"id":"p15s12","text":" 9100) tunnels are loopback usbmux forwards over the USB link; they sit behind the same signed-route"},{"id":"p15s13","text":" fence, and the browser still only ever talks to the DSH webserver origin.
- **Orphan adoption/recla"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"im** — if a previous DSH host was killed ungracefully and its serve-sim helper survived, the same de"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"vice is adopted (the orphan's handshake is authoritative); a stale helper squatting on a slot for a "},{"id":"p15s16","text":"different device is reclaimed via `serve-sim -k` and relaunched once.
- **Keep-alive + idle stop** —"},{"id":"p15s17","text":" a crashed stream restarts in the background (~5 s delay); with zero consumers the stream stops auto"},{"id":"p15s18","text":"matically after 5 minutes. Intentional stops are never fought. (The real-device runner is exempt fro"},{"id":"p15s19","text":"m the idle reaping on purpose: restarting it costs a multi-minute `xcodebuild` rebuild.)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **macOS with full Xcode** — not just Command Line Tools. `xcodebuild`, `xcrun simctl`, and the sim"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ulator runtimes all ship with Xcode.
- **At least one iOS Simulator runtime** installed in Xcode.
- "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"**DSH ≥ 0.1.0-rc.6 with the web bundle** for the panel. Headless profiles work too: all 22 tools fun"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ction normally, just without the live view.
- **Non-macOS hosts**: the plugin loads and all 22 tools"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" register, but every call returns an explanatory error (`iOS Simulator requires macOS with Xcode …`)"},{"id":"p17s6","text":".
- **serve-sim** ships as an npm dependency of this plugin, so it resolves locally on real installs"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"; the `npx -y serve-sim` fallback covers development trees (first use needs network).
- **AXe** (opt"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ional — only the AXe-backed tools need it: `ios_sim_ui_tree` / `ios_sim_tap_element`, plus `ios_sim_"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ui_rows` / `ios_sim_tap_row` on a simulator): `brew install cameroncooke/axe/axe`, or let the plugin"},{"id":"p17s10","text":" auto-download the pinned release (v1.8.0, SHA-256 verified) into `~/Library/Caches/dsh-ios/bin`. `D"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"SHPLUGIN_IOS_AXE_BIN` overrides resolution; `DSHPLUGIN_IOS_AXE_OFFLINE=1` disables the download.
- *"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"*Vision OCR** (optional — only `ios_sim_find_text` / `ios_sim_tap_text` need it): the plugin compile"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"s its bundled `assets/ocr.swift` with `swiftc` on first use into `~/Library/Caches/dsh-ios/bin/ocr` "},{"id":"p17s14","text":"(zh-Hans + en-US recognition).
- **lldb attach** needs macOS Developer Mode: run `sudo DevToolsSecur"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"ity -enable` once. Until then `ios_sim_backtrace` uses Xcode's `sample` engine (non-suspending) and "},{"id":"p17s16","text":"`ios_sim_leaks` degrades with the enable hint.
